title: SOFA Buddy Settings
description: Factory defaults for SOFA Buddy.  Surfaced settings are managed by the UI; advanced.* and averaging.* keys must be edited here.

schema_version.description: Internal version identifier used by the migration path in config.py. Do not change manually.

default.description: Use per-source-folder output locations. When true, each SOFA file is written alongside its source folder; when false the single custom 'folder' path is used as the shared root.

folder.description: Custom output root folder path.  Only used when 'default' is false.

enabled.description: Enable the SOFA mastering stage. Input SOFA files are resampled, globally aligned, and optionally radius-normalised and DF-equalised before DFHRTF analysis.

samplerates.description: Target samplerates (Hz) to export. Each selected samplerate produces a separate mastered SOFA file.

phase_mode.description: Phase treatment for the HRIR output. 'Original Phase' preserves the measured phase response unmodified.

lf_extension.description: Extend the HRIR below the measurement's reliable low-frequency limit by blending in a synthetic min-phase signal derived from the reference LF curve (data/lf_ref_mag.txt).

xover.description: Crossover frequency (Hz) for LF extension blending. The synthetic LF signal is spliced in below this frequency; blend width is controlled by advanced.blend_low_oct / blend_high_oct.

uneq.description: Output an un-equalized (raw diffuse-field) SOFA file in addition to the DF-equalized variant.

dfeq.description: Apply diffuse-field equalization — each HRIR is divided by the geometry-weighted DF average response so the net speaker-to-ear transfer is flat on average.

normalize_distance.description: Harmonize all HRIRs to a common listening radius using physics-based delay correction (sample-accurate fractional delay) and inverse-square gain scaling.

distance_m.description: Target listening radius in metres for distance normalization. Typical values are 1.0 – 2.0 m.

hrir_length.description: Output HRIR length in samples after processing and windowing. Shorter lengths reduce CPU/memory cost at the expense of LF resolution.

ild_fix.description: Balance inter-aural level differences (ILD) in mastered SOFA files. Applies a split-level broadband scalar correction when the estimated diffuse-field ILD exceeds ild_threshold.

ild_threshold.description: ILD correction threshold in dB. Files whose estimated diffuse-field ILD (300–6000 Hz mean) exceeds this value are corrected. Calibration offsets are typically ≥ 1.5 dB; acoustic ILD is usually < 0.5 dB.

naming.description: Output filename template for mastered SOFA files. Supported variables: {folder}, {filename}, {samplerate}, {eq}.

processing_length.description: Internal FFT processing length in samples. Must be ≥ hrir_length; larger values reduce time-domain aliasing during convolution steps.

norm_target_db.description: Peak normalization target level in dBFS applied to each output SOFA file after all processing.

onset_buffer.description: Extra samples prepended before the detected HRIR onset when aligning impulse responses. Provides headroom for pre-ringing.

onset_threshold_ratio.description: Fraction of the HRIR's peak amplitude used to detect the onset sample (first sample that exceeds peak × threshold).

blend_low_oct.description: Lower fade width in octaves below sofa.xover. The synthetic LF signal starts blending in at xover / 2^blend_low_oct.

blend_high_oct.description: Upper fade width in octaves above sofa.xover. The original signal is fully restored at xover × 2^blend_high_oct.

ild_low_freq.description: Lower edge (Hz) of the frequency band used to estimate the diffuse-field ILD for correction. Default 300 Hz.

ild_high_freq.description: Upper edge (Hz) of the frequency band used to estimate the diffuse-field ILD for correction. Default 6000 Hz.

advanced.description: Advanced SOFA mastering tunables. Not surfaced in the UI — edit this file directly.

enabled.description: Enable the DFHRTF extraction stage. Computes geometry-weighted spectral averages from SOFA files, applies smoothing and tilt, and writes text and/or graph outputs.

per_sofa_lr.description: Write separate per-channel (L and R) DFHRTF text files for each SOFA file.

per_sofa_avg.description: Write a single averaged DFHRTF text file per SOFA file, combining L and R via the algorithm selected in per_sofa_avg_algo.

per_sofa_avg_algo.description: Algorithm used to average the L and R DFHRTF curves when writing per-SOFA average outputs.

text_filename.description: Text output filename template. Supported variables: {folder}, {filename}, {samplerate}, {tilt}, {LR}.

text_delimiter.description: Column delimiter written in DFHRTF text output files.

text_extension.description: File extension for DFHRTF text output files.

dfhrtf_graphs.description: Generate a DFHRTF magnitude plot for each processed SOFA file.

weighted_grid.description: Generate a geometry-weighted measurement grid visualization plot.

weighted_grid_scope.description: Whether the weighted grid plot is computed per source folder or once across all input files.

graph_filename.description: Graph output filename template. Supported variables: {folder}, {filename}, {samplerate}, {tilt}, {graphtype}.

graph_extension.description: Image format for graph output files.

smoothing.description: Fractional-octave smoothing bandwidth applied to the DFHRTF magnitude curve (e.g. 24 = 1/24-octave smoothing).

tilt.description: Spectral tilt applied to the DFHRTF output in dB/octave. Negative values roll off the high frequencies; 0.0 means no tilt.

extend_lf.description: Extend the DFHRTF below its reliable LF limit by blending in the reference LF curve (data/lf_ref_mag.txt).

xover.description: Crossover frequency (Hz) for DFHRTF LF extension blending.

avg_all.description: Compute a global average DFHRTF across all processed SOFA files after per-file extraction completes.

algo.description: Algorithm used for global multi-file averaging.

exclude_outliers.description: Remove curves whose pairwise Soft-DTW distance from the median exceeds averaging.outlier_threshold_std standard deviations before global averaging.

n_fft.description: FFT size for DFHRTF spectral computation. Larger values give finer frequency resolution but increase processing time.

output_octave_fraction.description: Output frequency grid resolution in fractional octaves for DFHRTF text files (e.g. 48 = 1/48-octave spacing).

norm_freq_hz.description: Reference frequency (Hz) at which the DFHRTF magnitude is normalized to 0 dB before writing outputs.

lf_blend_low_oct.description: Lower fade width in octaves below dfhrtf.xover for DFHRTF LF extension blending.

lf_blend_high_oct.description: Upper fade width in octaves above dfhrtf.xover for DFHRTF LF extension blending.

stereo_angle_deg.description: Azimuth angle (degrees) used when extracting L/R off-axis curves for stereo graph outputs.

advanced.description: Advanced DFHRTF extraction tunables. Not surfaced in the UI — edit this file directly.

num_points.description: Number of log-spaced frequency points onto which all DFHRTF curves are resampled before averaging.

outlier_threshold_std.description: Outlier rejection threshold in standard deviations above the median pairwise distance. Curves exceeding median + N×std are removed.

outlier_gamma.description: Soft-DTW gamma parameter used during outlier detection. Controls the softness of the distance metric (higher = smoother gradient).

softdtw_gamma_persofa.description: Soft-DTW gamma parameter for per-SOFA L+R barycenter averaging. Smaller values approach hard-DTW; larger values approach Euclidean mean.

softdtw_gamma_global.description: Soft-DTW gamma parameter for global multi-file barycenter averaging.

softdtw_max_iter.description: Maximum L-BFGS-B iterations for the Soft-DTW barycenter optimizer.

softdtw_tol.description: Convergence tolerance for the Soft-DTW barycenter optimizer. Iteration stops when the gradient norm falls below this value.

geo_arc_y_scale.description: Y-axis scale factor applied before arc-length parameterization in the geometric arc-length blend algorithm. Balances frequency vs. magnitude contribution to curve distance.

averaging.description: Global averaging pipeline settings. Not surfaced in the UI — edit this file directly.
